description: Choose what Porch sends back to callers, for the whole inbox or a sub-path: status, headers and body. Useful for webhook verification handshakes, or a friendly page after an OAuth redirect (or a 302 with a Location header). Pages are served in a browser sandbox: scripts and forms do not run. Pass reset: true to go back to the default.

content_type.description: Content-Type of the body (default text/plain, or text/html if the body starts with "<").

inbox_key.description: The inbox_key returned by create_inbox (starts with "porch_sk_").

path_prefix.description: Apply to this path and everything below it (default "/", the whole inbox). The longest matching prefix wins.

reset.description: Remove the response set for path_prefix and fall back to the default.

name: set_response
title: Set response
